responsibility: Provides core register-related declarations, macros, and inline helpers shared across GCC’s RTL middle end and back end. It exposes per-function pseudo-register statistics, frequencies, calls-crossed counts, reg_renumber and caller-save state, target-dependent hard-register layout tables, and utility operations for manipulating hard-register ranges and testing containment/overlap by mode or count. This header is foundational register infrastructure used by allocation, reload, scheduling, and dataflow code.
